text: 1. Foreign citizens holding valid foreign passports, friendly to China, and with no criminal records.2. The eligibility for application should comply with the relevant regulations of China's Ministry of Education.3. Applicants should be between 18 and 25 years old and have graduated from high school.Language RequirementsFor applications to English-taught programs, the applicants must meet one of the following conditions:1. English is the native language or official language;2. Obtain a TOEFL iBT score of 78 or above, IELTS (Academic) 6.0 or above,100 or above in Duolingo, or an equivalent score in other internationally recognized English proficiency tests;3. Have obtained an academic certificate in a country where English is the native language;4. If unable to provide standardized English test scores, applicants must take the English test organized by the university.For applications to Chinese-taught programs, the applicants must have an HSK4 score of 180 or above. Applicants whose previous qualification was taught in Chinese or whose native language is Chinese may be exempt from submitting HSK scores subject to the recognition of the university.
